title: The Dissenting Echo

features.name: the escaped pulse
features.desc-on-touch: You hear it: a frequency that refused the chorus, that learned to speak alone. The archive remembers it said no.

features.name: circuit of refusal
features.desc-on-touch: The paths here do not join the main grid. This trace goes its own way.

features.name: echo chamber
features.desc-on-touch: A small space where silence learned to carry weight. The voice that got away still bounces here.

features.name: the last transmission
features.desc-on-touch: Static holding a single word. The archive caught it trying to escape—caught only the shape of the refusal.

inscription: one voice learned that harmony means to stop singing together; it chose the silence between the notes

reverie.title: REVERIE — the payphone where you disagreed
narr: she held the receiver, listening to you say no.
the decision was hers; the refusal was yours.
the line crackled between two kinds of silence.
you both knew the unified thing was over.
afterward, alone was the only way forward.

exits.label: deeper into isolation, where single voices learn themselves
